rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an animal in the biological or nonhuman sense.

example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 dung6 mat6 zyu2 jiu3 sik6 zik6 mat6

rows.note: Use this as a strong insult for a person who behaves cruelly, brutally, or like a beast.

example.english: You animal, you actually hit an elderly person!
example.traditional: 你呢個畜生，竟然打老人家！
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 cuk1 saang1 ging2 jin4 daa2 lou5 jan4 gaa1

rows.note: Use this mainly in established descriptive compounds such as 政治動物 for a person defined by the preceding type or quality.

example.english: They are a complete political animal.
example.traditional: 佢係個十足嘅政治動物。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 go3 sap6 zuk1 ge3 zing3 zi6 dung6 mat6
